title: CI diagnostic: merge dev-next into dev
summary: This PR merges dev-next into dev, introducing a shared lifecycle driver contract, removing local audio primitives in favor of external packages, and adding Webots simulator network and runtime-state improvements. CI produced no machine-readable scenario summary and no logs were captured, so the test outcome is unknown. The change set is large and touches CI workflow, manifests, and simulator scripts.
pr_changes: Added shared lifecycle driver contract and legacy-compatible driver TOMLs for various primitives/services
Removed local audio_driver and audio_client_bridge primitives, replaced with external package URLs
Updated Webots simulator scripts for bridge networking, soma runtime mount, and rviz PID management
Added config.spec files for tiago_camera, tiago_chassis, tiago_lidar
Added test_manifest_config.py and test_container_network.sh for deployment config validation
Modified CI workflow to handle root-owned artifacts and pre-create soma-runtime directory
test_result: No machine-readable scenario summary was produced and no logs were embedded, so Webots CI exercised nothing observable in this context. The summary reports total=0, passed=0, failed=0, indicating no test results were captured.

evidence.text: No machine-readable scenario summary was produced; logs are still embedded below.

suggested_fix: Investigate why CI produced no scenario summary or logs; ensure the CI pipeline captures and reports test results for future runs.
risks_or_watchouts: Removal of local audio primitives may break deployments that rely on local ALSA audio
New shared lifecycle driver contract may require updates to existing provider manifests
Bridge network mode requires explicit ROBONIX_ZENOH_ROUTER setting; misconfiguration could cause DDS communication failures
Soma runtime mount creation in CI may fail if directory permissions are not handled correctly
